title: perf(canary): add automated throughput regression detection + hysteresis rollout guards
author: Ethan Li
description: Summary: Add automated throughput regression detection to the performance canary pipeline and introduce hysteresis-aware rollout guards to prevent flapping during transient noise. Motivation: We've seen two incidents where short-lived throughput spikes caused canary detectors to trigger premature rollbacks/pauses and blocked rollouts unnecessarily. This change improves robustness by adding: 1) throughput delta detection alongside latency; 2) configurable observation windows and sustained-failure thresholds; 3) hysteresis so that a guard that pauses a rollout requires a sustained recovery period before resuming; 4) tighter integration between perf-canary service and rollout-controller so pause/resume is automated and auditable. Changes: - services/perf-canary: implement throughput detector (moving-window TPS comparison, percent-drop heuristic), add sustained-fail counter and recovery counter, expose new health metrics (canary_throughput_drop_pct, canary_sustained_fails, canary_recovery_rate). - controller/rollout: add guard actions to pause/mark-canary-failed with reason payload, add backoff timer tied to hysteresis settings. - observability: Grafana dashboards updated to show throughput detector timeline, add alerting rules for persistent regressions. - config: new cluster-level defaults for hysteresis (observation_window_seconds, sustained_failure_seconds, recovery_seconds) and per-rollout overrides. - tests: unit tests for detector math, integration tests wiring perf-canary -> rollout-controller, end-to-end perf test with synthetic traffic. - docs: runbook and README additions describing new thresholds and recommended tuning. Commit summary: - Implement throughput detector and sustained-fail logic - Expose metrics and update dashboards - Integrate pause/resume actions in rollout-controller - Add tests and docs - Add feature flag to opt-in on first rollout Migration / rollout notes: This is behind a feature flag perf_canary_v2 and will be enabled for internal staging and a small set of customer pilots. Default cluster settings are conservative (10% throughput drop sustained for 120s will pause). Please review the tuning section before enabling in production. Checklist: - [x] Detector implemented - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Dashboard and alerts updated - [x] Runbook updated - [x] Feature-flag gated - [x] Can be disabled via rollout policy Backwards compatibility: New metrics and controller actions are additive; old canary behavior preserved when feature flag is off. Risk: Mis-tuned thresholds could pause rollouts; recommended to enable only in controlled pilots and monitor canary_sustained_fails metric. Related: ENG-2045 (perf canary improvements), ENG-2090 (rollout controller guard actions).
